1. **Long-Term Outcomes of Glucagon-Like Peptide-1 Receptor Agonists in Patients With Peripheral Artery Disease and Type 2 Diabetes.**
   Authors: Akiva Rosenzveig, Leben Tefera, Ankit Agrawal, Judah Rajendran, Faysal Massad, Osamah Badwan, Julia Wajsberg, Pulkit Chaudhury, David Zidar, Timir K Paul, Deepak L Bhatt, Aravinda Nanjundappa
   Journal: Journal of the American Heart Association
   Publication Date: 2026-10-08
   PMID: 42383806
   Abstract: Peripheral artery disease (PAD) affects >236 million people globally, particularly among those with type 2 diabetes. GLP-1 (glucagon-like peptide-1) receptor agonists (GLP-1 RAs) offer cardiovascular and kidney benefits, but their impact on PAD-specific outcomes is underexplored. This study evalu...
   URL: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42383806/

2. **Clinical characteristics and intensification patterns in subjects with "early" type 2 diabetes in Italy- an analysis from the AMD annals initiative.**
   Authors: Giuseppina T Russo, Antonio Nicolucci, Alessandro Cuttone, Antonio Ceriello, Valeria Manicardi, Alberto Rocca, Francesco Prattichizzo, Giuseppe Lucisano, Salvatore Corrao, Salvatore De Cosmo, Graziano Di Cianni, Riccardo Candido
   Journal: Acta diabetologica
   Publication Date: 2026-04-02
   PMID: 41165847
   PMC ID: 13046648 (Full text available)
   Abstract: Characteristics defining "early" type 2 diabetes (T2D) are unclear, and type and timing of treatment intensification with glucose-lowering drugs (GLD) in these patients are understudied.
